BiblicalUsage: Peresh was the son of Maachah, wife of Machir, and the brother of Sheresh. His sons were Ulam and Rakem, and his name stands in the genealogy of Manasseh, one line in the record of the tribe.
TheologicalSignificance: I am sure that God keeps the single lines: Peresh has one verse, and it is enough to place him in the house of Manasseh.
